bosses.name: Pusillin
bosses.general: The imp runs off when you talk to him; chase him through the wing. At the end he fights with imp friends: Fireball, Blast Wave.
bosses.tank: Grab his imps at the end.

bosses.name: Zevrim Thornhoof
bosses.general: Sacrifice pins a player and drains them, Intense Pain hurts the tank.

bosses.name: Hydrospawn
bosses.general: Water elemental: Riptide, Submersion, and he splits into Hydrolings at low health.
bosses.healer: Several on the tank at the end.

bosses.name: Lethtendris
bosses.general: With her imp Pimgib: Shadow Bolt Volley, Enfeeble, Void Bolt.

bosses.name: Alzzin the Wildshaper
bosses.general: Changes form as he loses health and hits harder in his beast forms; Wither and Enervate weaken the group.
bosses.tank: Keep him in the open, cooldowns for his beast forms.
bosses.healer: Dispel what you can; heavy tank damage late.

bosses.name: Tendris Warpwood
bosses.general: Huge treant: Entangle roots everyone, Grasping Vines and Trample. His Ironbark Protectors are nearby.
bosses.tank: Hold him away from the protectors.
bosses.healer: Dispel the roots, heal the trample.

bosses.name: Illyanna Ravenoak
bosses.general: Hunter with her bear Ferra: Volley, Immolation Trap, Concussive Shot.
bosses.dps: Ferra first or crowd control it; spread for the volley.

bosses.name: Magister Kalendris
bosses.general: Shadow priest: Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Pain, and Dominate Mind on a player.
bosses.tank: Hold him; don't hit the controlled player.
bosses.healer: Dispel the mind control and the Shadow Word: Pain.

bosses.name: Immol'thar
bosses.general: Freed by destroying the five pylons. Trample, Infected Bite, Eyes of Immol'thar come out, and Portal of Immol'thar sends a player away.
bosses.tank: Face him away; he hits hard.
bosses.healer: Cure the disease; heal whoever he portals.

bosses.name: Prince Tortheldrin
bosses.general: Whirlwind cuts the melee; Arcane Blast, Counterspell, and he pulls a player to him.
bosses.dps: Melee step out of Whirlwind; casters watch the counterspell.

bosses.name: Guard Mol'dar
bosses.general: Gordok guard. Kill him for loot or leave him alive for the tribute.

bosses.name: Stomper Kreeg
bosses.general: Drunk ogre: War Stomp and Whirlwind. Leave him alive for the tribute, or kill him.

bosses.name: Guard Fengus
bosses.general: Gordok guard. Kill him or leave him for the tribute.

bosses.name: Guard Slip'kik
bosses.general: Gordok guard. A Freezing Trap trick gets you past him for the tribute.

bosses.name: Captain Kromcrush
bosses.general: Intimidating Shout fears and Mortal Strike; he calls Gordok Reavers.
bosses.tank: Fear Ward or Tremor; grab the reavers.
bosses.healer: Heal ahead of the mortal strikes.

bosses.name: Cho'Rush the Observer
bosses.general: King Gordok's ogre mage: heals Gordok and casts Mind Blast.

bosses.name: King Gordok
bosses.general: Kill Cho'Rush first. Gordok: Mortal Strike, War Stomp, Berserker Charge.
bosses.tank: Face Gordok away from the group.
bosses.healer: Heal ahead of the mortal strikes.
bosses.dps: Cho'Rush first, then Gordok from behind.
